newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's overnight rates change little.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's overnight rates change little.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates finished on Thursday at around Wednesday's levels as the market remained liquid, dealers said.
The overnight rates ended at 20.875 percent, compared with Wednesday's closing rates of about 20.75 percent.
Dealers said offers came down since yesterday and this may indicate that the overnight rates will drop slightly in the next few days.
"Offers were usually above 21 percent yesterday, only OTP kept 21, but today everyubody came down to the 21 level," said Europai Kereskedelmi Bank's Csaba Fekete.
Dealers said the market's liquidity was good despite a five-day run of depositors on Postabank, which is usually among the largest lenders of the market.
The run ended on Monday, and dealers said it did not influence the interbank market as most of the money taken out of Postabank was likely to be deposited with other banks.
They added that the overnight rates may drop to 20.5 percent in the next few days.
